datiRaccolti.intro: We collect the following categories of personal data:
datiRaccolti.registrazione: Registration data: name, email address, password (cryptographic hash)
datiRaccolti.profilo: Profile data: profile photo, date of birth, sex, weight, height, fitness goal
datiRaccolti.allenamento: Workout data: sessions, exercises, sets, reps, loads, personal records
datiRaccolti.tecnici: Technical data: IP address, browser type, technical session cookies
datiRaccolti.comunicazione: Communication data: messages in the internal chat

baseGiuridica.consenso: Consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR): for optional features such as gamification, profile visibility and shared statistics
baseGiuridica.contratto: Performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR): to provide the service (account management, workouts, communications)
baseGiuridica.interesse: Legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR): for security, abuse prevention and service improvement

conservazione.intro: Personal data is retained for as long as necessary for the purposes for which it was collected:
conservazione.account: Account data: until the account is deleted
conservazione.allenamento: Workout data: until the account is deleted or upon request
conservazione.chat: Chat messages: according to the retention settings configured by the user (default: 7 days)

diritti.intro: Under Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR), you have the right to:
diritti.accesso: Access: obtain confirmation of the processing and a copy of your data
diritti.cancellazione: Erasure: request the deletion of your data ("right to be forgotten")
diritti.limitazione: Restriction: restrict the processing in certain circumstances
diritti.portabilita: Portability: receive your data in a structured and readable format
diritti.opposizione: Objection: object to processing based on legitimate interest
diritti.revoca: Withdrawal of consent: withdraw your consent at any time
diritti.esercizio: You can download a complete copy of your data yourself, in JSON format, at any time from Profile → Privacy → Your data; from Profile you can also delete your account. To exercise your other rights, contact us through the GitHub profile indicated above.

sicurezza.intro: We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your data:

trasferimento.testo: Data is stored on self-hosted servers in the European Union. We do not transfer personal data to third countries outside the European Economic Area (EEA).

modifiche.testo: We reserve the right to update this policy. Changes will be communicated through the application. Continued use of the service after notification constitutes acceptance of the changes.
